scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix api && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run db:migrate:local
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint
